702	                .unwrap_or_default();
703	            let synced_count = manifest
704	                .profiles
705	                .iter()

707	                .map_or(0, |p| p.synced_files.len());
708	            let profile_count = manifest.profiles.len();

719	            );
720	
721	            // Add git status info
722	            let status = &self.git_status;
723	
724	            // Show ahead/behind info
725	            if status.ahead > 0 || status.behind > 0 {
726	                stats.push_str("\n\nRemote Status:");
727	                if status.behind > 0 {

1104	                        if mouse.column >= update_rect.x
1105	                            && mouse.column < update_rect.x + update_rect.width
1106	                            && mouse.row >= update_rect.y
1107	                            && mouse.row < update_rect.y + update_rect.height
1108	                        {

1115	                    }
1116	
1117	                    // Check if click is in any menu clickable area
1118	                    if let Some(&menu_item) = self.clickable_areas.hit_test(mouse.column, mouse.row)
1119	                    {
1120	                        self.set_selected_item(menu_item);

1122	                        if menu_item.is_enabled(is_setup) {
